high_level_description: The image is an infographic titled "Humanity today and humanity's past" from the website Our World in Data. It uses an hourglass to visually represent the population of humans over time, with each grain of sand representing 10 million people. The hourglass is divided into three sections: the top, middle, and bottom. The top section represents the present day, while the bottom section represents the distant past. The middle section, which is the thickest part of the hourglass, represents the historical period between the present and the distant past.
